output.summary: Keep default runtime worktree roots inside the project sandbox.

approvedRows.question: Should default runtime Git worktree paths stay inside the CodeWiki checkout instead of an external sibling directory?
approvedRows.currentState: Default worktree planning used a sibling .codewiki-worktrees directory outside the repository root, which can cross Pi sandbox boundaries.
approvedRows.desiredState: Default worktree planning uses .codewiki/runtime/tmp/<trace-id>/worktree/** inside the CodeWiki project, while explicit custom roots remain available for hosts that allow them.
approvedRows.rationale: Project-scoped Pi sandboxes can block or intercept external filesystem access, so default worktree scratch paths must be repo-local before real worker dispatch is safe.
approvedRows.userImpact: Users get safer supervised runtime dispatch because default worktree commands no longer target paths outside the project sandbox.
approvedRows.maintainerImpact: Maintainers get tests documenting the sandbox-safe default and explicit override behavior.
approvedRows.recommendationRationale: Evidence supports this intention as valuable and safe to plan.
